user_requirement: Server shelf cooling: read a DHT22 every 2 seconds and switch a relay on when the temperature rises above 30 degrees.

components.name: DHT22 temperature sensor
components.notes: 10k pull-up between DATA and 3V3; call measure() before temperature()/humidity()

components.name: Relay module - cooling fan
components.notes: value(1) = ON, value(0) = OFF (active-HIGH); state printed as RELAY:ON/OFF
